evidence.title: Obama Foundation workers move to unionize over benefits, working conditions months after center opens

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation workers' letter
occurrences.quote_span: "Amidst increasing workloads we have seen our benefits rolled back and support from leadership to be minimal. When we voice concerns we are met with vague responses, leading to uncertainty about our future with the foundation," the workers wrote.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation workers
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Workers United organizing documents and NLRB records
occurrences.quote_span: The workers are invoking Obama's own public support for organized labor as they seek to form Obama Workers United, urging foundation leadership to respect their right to organize.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation workers
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Barack Obama's 2016 letter on organized labor
occurrences.quote_span: "If I were looking for a good job that lets me build some security for my family, I’d join a union. If I saw a problem in my workplace, I’d organize my coworkers to do something about it," Obama wrote at the time, according to the employees' letter.
occurrences.speaker: Barack Obama
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation statement to the Daily Mail
occurrences.quote_span: The Obama Foundation said it supports employees' right to organize in a statement previously provided to the Daily Mail.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation organizing committee communications and AFSCME Council 31 records
occurrences.quote_span: The organizing committee, working with the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees Council 31, also urged foundation leadership not to interfere with the unionization effort.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation organizing committee
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation statement defending executive compensation
occurrences.quote_span: The foundation defended its executive compensation at the time, saying salaries reflected competitive market rates for comparable nonprofit organizations.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation 2024 Form 990
occurrences.quote_span: The workers' complaints come months after Fox News Digital reported that Obama Foundation CEO Valerie Jarrett, a longtime Obama confidante, earned $740,000 in 2024,
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation organizing committee letter
occurrences.quote_span: "We urge senior leadership to honor our legal right to form a union and not waste resources on anti-union messaging, anti-union lawyers, or anti-union meetings," the letter states.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation organizing committee
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation organizing committee communications and AFSCME Council 31 records
occurrences.quote_span: The organizing committee, working with the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees Council 31, also urged foundation leadership not to interfere with the unionization effort.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation organizing committee
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama's 2016 letter encouraging Americans to join unions
occurrences.quote_span: The workers then pointed to Obama's own words from a 2016 letter encouraging Americans to join unions.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation workers
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation statement on union representation
occurrences.quote_span: "As members of our staff explore union representation, we approach this process with immense gratitude for their contributions, deep respect for unions, and a sincere commitment to working collaboratively with our partners in labor."
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation spokesperson statement
occurrences.quote_span: "We are deeply committed to the fundamental right of workers to organize and make their voices heard," a foundation spokesperson said.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Proposed union bargaining-unit documents and NLRB filings
occurrences.quote_span: The proposed union would represent more than 250 employees across the foundation's Chicago campus, Washington, D.C., offices and remote positions nationwide, according to the Daily Mail.
occurrences.speaker: Daily Mail
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation workers' unionization letter
occurrences.quote_span: Employees at former President Barack Obama's foundation are moving to unionize, accusing leadership of rolling back benefits, failing to address workplace concerns and driving away experienced staff, according to a letter reviewed by Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation Form 990 filings for 2018 and 2024
occurrences.quote_span: while the organization's total salaries and benefits climbed from $18.5 million in 2018 to $43.7 million in 2024.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation employees' signed letter and Obama Foundation staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: In the letter, signed by dozens of employees, workers said increasing workloads, reduced benefits and a lack of support from leadership have contributed to high staff turnover at the foundation, which operates the recently opened Obama Presidential Center in Chicago.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation workers
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers

occurrences.checkable_against: Obama Foundation employee departure and staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: The employees said departing colleagues have taken valuable institutional knowledge with them, leaving remaining staff struggling to keep up with their responsibilities.
occurrences.speaker: Obama Foundation workers
occurrences.subject: Obama Foundation workers
